props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the transcript list.

props.name: currentTime
props.description: Playback position in seconds. The line it falls in is highlighted and followed.

props.name: onSeek
props.description: Called when a line is clicked or activated with Enter, with that line’s start time.

props.name: searchable
props.description: Show the search field above the transcript.

props.name: autoScroll
props.description: Keep the current line in view as playback moves. Pauses while the reader scrolls.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the scrolling list in pixels.

props.name: formatTime
props.description: Format a start time. Defaults to m:ss, or h:mm:ss past the hour.
